description: Optimization decomposed. Lagrange duality, semi-definite programming, second-order cone programming, interior point methods, ADMM, proximal methods, stochastic optimization, Nesterov acceleration, non-convex optimization landscapes.

sub_mechanisms.name: Lagrange_duality
sub_mechanisms.definition: Min f(x) s.t. g(x) ≤ 0 → dual problem max min L(x,λ) = f(x) + λg(x).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation constrained optimization. Strong duality under Slater's condition. SVM derivation.

sub_mechanisms.name: weak_strong_duality
sub_mechanisms.definition: Dual ≤ primal (weak). Equality under convexity + constraint qualification (strong).
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Gap zero in convex case. Used to bound primal + verify optimality.

sub_mechanisms.name: SDP_semidefinite
sub_mechanisms.definition: Min trace(CX) s.t. trace(A_i X) = b_i, X positive semidefinite.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Generalises LP + QP. MaxCut, SDP relaxations. Convex.

sub_mechanisms.name: interior_point_methods
sub_mechanisms.definition: Barrier function pushes iterates away from boundary. Polynomial-time for LP + SDP.
sub_mechanisms.why: Karmarkar 1984. Modern LP/SDP solvers. Polynomial worst-case.

sub_mechanisms.name: ADMM
sub_mechanisms.definition: Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers. Splits problem into easier subproblems.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Big data + distributed optimization. ML at scale. Boyd's book canonical.

sub_mechanisms.name: proximal_operator
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Handles non-smooth functions. ISTA, FISTA for L1-regularised.

sub_mechanisms.name: stochastic_gradient_descent_math
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation ML. Scales to large datasets. Convergence rates well-studied.

sub_mechanisms.name: Nesterov_acceleration
sub_mechanisms.definition: Add momentum term. Accelerated rate O(1/k²) for convex smooth.
sub_mechanisms.why: Optimal first-order method. Foundation. Adam + similar borrow ideas.

sub_mechanisms.name: mirror_descent
sub_mechanisms.definition: Generalises GD using Bregman divergences. Adapted geometry.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Exponential weights for online learning. Better for high-dim.

sub_mechanisms.name: non_convex_landscape
sub_mechanisms.definition: Saddle points, local minima, plateaus. NP-hard general.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Deep networks non-convex but trainable. Loss landscape research.

sub_mechanisms.name: frank_wolfe_method
sub_mechanisms.definition: Linear oracle minimises over feasible set. Update direction.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Convex constraint set with cheap linear minimisation. No projection step.

sub_mechanisms.name: saddle_point_problems
sub_mechanisms.definition: Min-max problems. GAN training. Extragradient + similar methods.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation. Different from minimisation. Convergence subtle. Modern ML.

derivation_rules.name: strong_duality_holds_for_convex_Slater
derivation_rules.why: Foundation. Dual solution equals primal. Standard verification of optimality via KKT.

derivation_rules.name: Nesterov_optimal_first_order
if: convex smooth function minimised by first-order method
then: Nesterov acceleration achieves optimal O(1/k²) rate
derivation_rules.why: Foundation. Lower bound matches. Gradient descent only O(1/k). Universal in ML.

derivation_rules.name: SGD_unbiased_gradient_converges
if: stochastic gradient has E[ĝ] = ∇f + bounded variance
derivation_rules.why: Foundation ML. Robbins-Monro. Rate depends on step size schedule. Universal.

derivation_rules.name: interior_point_polynomial_LP
if: LP solved with interior point method
derivation_rules.why: Karmarkar's breakthrough. Simplex exponential worst case (Klee-Minty). IPM modern default.

derivation_rules.name: non_convex_local_global_gap
then: local minimum may not be global
derivation_rules.why: Fundamental. Deep learning landscape: many local minima, mostly good. Theory active research.
